about_the_game:
Fabulous Fool is a card-based RPG roguelike where battles play like inverted solitaire: enemies play cards, and you counter their moves with a higher card of the same suit or a trump. Every card you successfully parry damages the opponent, while anything you fail to counter hits you. Stack your cards into chains and trigger a combo system that multiplies damage and special effects.

Collect and combine three resource types:

  • Demons — tactical abilities you attach to cards to bend the rules in your favor.

  • Relics — passive artifacts that define your deck’s style and long-term synergies.

  • Potions — powerful single-use effects for clutch moments.

Together they enable wild chain reactions and intriguing builds.

Welcome to the Kingdom of Fools — a grotesque world where everything obeys card logic. Legend says the winner of A.C.E. — the Arcane Championship of Exiles — earns freedom. But the truth is far crueler… Bright colors hide something unsettling; the story is told through details — the texts of cards, relics, enemies, and brief encounters with the tournament’s contestants. The world shifts as you progress — each cycle hardens its ruthless rules.
